convert_ckpt_to_diffusers_pipeline: convert a Stable Diffusion .ckpt or .safetensors checkpoint file into a Diffusers pipeline object
convert_controlnet_from_ckpt: convert an original ControlNet checkpoint file into a Diffusers ControlNetModel
convert_ldm_unet_checkpoint: convert a raw LDM checkpoint state dict into a Diffusers UNet2DConditionModel checkpoint
convert_ldm_vae_checkpoint: convert a raw LDM checkpoint state dict into a Diffusers AutoencoderKL VAE checkpoint
convert_open_clip_checkpoint: convert an OpenCLIP text encoder checkpoint into a Diffusers CLIPTextModel
